description:
S03 E05 — Killing a Champion

description:

title: Murder Under the Friday Night Lights
description:

The family of a high school cheerleader finds her murdered in her room the night after the homecoming dance; detectives surmise that she knew her killer, and because so many people are back in town for the big football game, everybody is a suspect.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

Vince Boston finds himself an unwitting accomplice to murder; he realizes his father, Silas, has been killing for years; he embarks on a mission to get justice for his father's many victims, which may include Vince's mother.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

When a hole appears in the backyard, Delila Yang gets suspicious; she knows her mother, Karina, dug it and knows someone is missing, but Delila doesn't yet realize she must work with police to trap her mom and unearth her sinister secrets.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

title: Evil Lives Here

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

LaTonya believes her husband, Nathan, is her best friend; over the years she suffers emotional abuse at his hands and decides to take their kids and leave; Nathan refuses to let go, leading to a night of terror that ends in a tragedy and a miracle.

title: Evil Lives Here
description:

As a child, Joy believes her mother, Anna Young, is the voice of God; in their isolated church community, Anna punishes anyone who breaks her rules, including young children; years later, Joy realizes her mother is not an angel but a killer.
